ours-md.settings: extract(doc, { url, markdown: true }) (timed); text and stats from article.markdown rendered by remark (GFM + math) and mdast-util-to-hast

ours-dart.settings: package:html parse, then extractTree(fromDocument(doc), url) (base href added as for Chromium); text = articleText(article)

ours-go.runtime: Go 1.24.7 native (PGO), own HTML5 parser, one process
ours-go.settings: ParseDocument(html), then ExtractTree(doc, { URL }) (base href added as for Chromium); text = articleText(article)

readability.settings: new Readability(doc).parse() defaults; text from content HTML

defuddle.settings: new Defuddle(doc, { url }).parse(), core bundle defaults; text from content HTML

trafilatura.settings: extract(tree, url, include_comments=False), txt output; stats from xml output

postlight.settings: Parser.parse(url, { html, fetchAllPages: false }); text from content HTML
